reference.role: Supplied design reference, creator/license unestablished; not newly authored art, a screenshot crop, runtime texture or game scene requirement

artwork.role: Original editable branch/leaf/mushroom/crystal frame; native 40px protected corners and 16px content margins
Original editable parchment/amber gradient; native 24px horizontal and 16px vertical corners
Original transparent six-cell atlas: gold/food/wood/stone/metal/cloth, always paired with native names

authoring: Manual editable SVG paths/gradients; runtime copies are byte-identical. No traced reference pixels, baked labels, terrain, generated 3D models or new asset pipeline.

font.role: Unmodified redistributable installed DejaVu Serif, copied with its complete license; not original artwork or a runtime install dependency

preserved_identity: docs/ui/exploration-assets.json still owns the unchanged editable Blender menu seal and exact 192px PNG, displayed at 48px
runtime_boundary: Only UI/ is portable. Reference and editable sources are repository design/authoring content, not runtime ZIP dependencies. Godot imports SVG/font resources independently.
whisperwood_refinement: Muted selected ornament bodies; existing structure, native contrast/states, topology and original seal retained. docs/whisperwood/ui-refined.json binds before/after.

selective_refinement.method: Selected SVG ornament body color substitutions only; paths/geometry and original native behavior unchanged. No wholesale artwork regeneration.
